primary_feature_set: conservative: exclude status and customer_value pending operational construction/availability verification
secondary_feature_set: all 13 source predictors; sensitivity analysis only, not eligible for primary model selection
row_policy: Retain all source observations; repeated profiles are not proven duplicate customers
group_policy: Identical conservative predictor vectors share a group in every train/validation/test split
holdout: First fold of shuffled StratifiedGroupKFold with five folds and seed 42
primary_selection_metric: Minimum pooled development out-of-fold Brier score among conservative-feature candidates and prior
uncertainty: 500 paired cluster-bootstrap resamples of held-out profile groups; conditional on the fitted models and this source sample
cost_scenarios: False-positive cost 1 and false-negative cost 5, 10, or 20 in explicitly hypothetical normalized units; thresholds selected on development OOF only
limitations: No U.S. carrier or employer generalization
Brier score measures overall probability error, not calibration alone
